## Signal stages

| Source column | Channel | Stage | Meaning |
| -- | -- | -- | -- |
| `time` | `time` | manufacturer_processed | Musclelab 1 kHz resampled, trial-relative time grid; vendor-constructed, not the native 2.56 kHz sensor clock |
| `distance` | `distance` | manufacturer_processed | Musclelab polynomial distance-time model evaluated on the 1 kHz grid; not native optical range samples |
| `velocity` | `velocity` | manufacturer_processed | Musclelab smoothed (step-averaged) velocity |
| `raw_velocity` | `velocity_vendor_unsmoothed` | manufacturer_processed | Musclelab unsmoothed velocity export labelled 'raw' by the source; vendor derivation undocumented; NOT native range data |

Package-derived (documented in `data-raw/laser-gun-data.R`, **not ingested**): `velocity_offset`: velocity <- velocity - min(velocity) after trimming time > 0.375 s; `trim`: rows with time <= 0.375 s, then time <= 0.414 s, removed (4805 rows remain); `raw_acceleration`: dv/dt of smoothed velocity: c(NA, diff(velocity) / diff(time)); `butter_acceleration`: 4th-order 1 Hz low-pass Butterworth, filtfilt, of raw_acceleration

### Time-base agreement between vendor distance and vendor velocity

* RMS(d(distance)/dt - velocity), 25 ms half-window: 2.088 m/s at zero lag; 0.09354 m/s at best lag **996 ms** (positive lag: vendor velocity trails the distance-derived speed; search ±2000 ms)

* The cause cannot be identified from manufacturer-processed exports. Any estimand that depends on the time origin (TD, split times read from distance, the distance-defined 30 m cut below) depends on which vendor channel defines t0.
